summary.text: Curt Massie is a Republican state representative from South Dakota House District 33 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a state and local tax consultant who previously worked as a senior auditor with the South Dakota Department of Revenue.

paragraphs.text: Curt Massie earned a B.S. in business administration and management from Black Hills State University in 1992.
His career includes work as a managing member of Dakota Business Tax, LLC, as a senior auditor with the South Dakota Department of Revenue, and as a state and local tax consultant.
Massie first won election to the House in 2022, defeating Democrat Vince Vidal in the general election, and was re-elected in 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026, and faces Democrat Kari Hall in the general election for the district's two seats.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the House Taxation Committee.
